title: HHHusher review list
description: A long column of reviews on a camel band: a small label on the left that stays in view, and in the right half one review after another (small yellow stars, a 28px quote, the author in bold mono), each rising 40px and fading in as it enters.
notes: the band is the theme's secondary (tan)
no top padding beyond a little: it follows hhhusher-statement
name: hhhusher-review-list

props.name: label
props.description: the small label on the left, e.g. "Reviews"

props.name: ratingLabel
props.description: screen-reader text for each star row, e.g. "5 out of 5 stars"
